final: SELECT grouped.zoneref, grouped.healtheval, grouped.avg_ratio, grouped.scan_count, grouped.avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, si.healtheval, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_ratio FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.healtheval)) AS excess FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, si.healtheval, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.healtheval) AS grouped WHERE grouped.avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, si.healtheval, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_ratio FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.healtheval)) ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
